sourceConflicts.finding: The official PDF really says extension450m2, existing500m2, contract100million yen. Official key is1 only. Choiceイ cannot be justified by the cited statutory scale rule; the earlier draft claim of a separate extension threshold is unsupported.
basis: Construction Recycling Act Enforcement Order art2(1)(2) explicitly limits extension area to the portion of the work and sets500m2. Existing500m2 cannot be summed with extension450m2 for this threshold.
Art2(1)(3)100million yen threshold expressly excludes new construction and extensions, so contract value alone does not rescue this450m2 extension.

Construction Business Act Enforcement Order art2 as of2026-01-01 sets50million yen (80million for building construction). Thusア45million mandatory supervising engineer is false, consistent with official key1, but does not resolveイ.
The disputed choice concerns Construction Recycling Act, not Waste Disposal Act (which is choiceエ).
